ideas.name: EU AI Act Compliance Evidence Gate
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: A living, timestamped evidence trail proving which AI systems a small business uses, how each is classified under the EU AI Act, and whether required documentation is current.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For European SMEs using AI tools, EU AI Act Compliance Evidence Gate provides a structured intake and Annex III risk-classification engine that generates timestamped, versioned evidence packs — proving compliance to enterprise customers and regulators before fines occur.
ideas.detailedDescription: National-authority enforcement began August 2, 2026. The AI-literacy obligation has no company size floor: a 3-person business using ChatGPT carries the same duty as a 300-person enterprise. Fines reach €15M or 3% global turnover. Model inventories live in spreadsheets and approvals happen over email. This system automates AI system inventorying, Annex III risk-tier classification, and evidence pack generation.

atAGlance.primaryBuyer: Founders, Operations Leads, and Compliance Officers at 1–50 person European businesses
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Structured Annex III questionnaire & generated versioned compliance evidence PDF
atAGlance.primaryRisk: Moving Digital Omnibus timeline shifts deadlines
atAGlance.killCondition: Zero interest from 20 target SME founders; enterprise buyers confirm simple self-declaration suffices

ideas.productConcept: Intake & Discovery -> LLM-Assisted Annex III Classification -> Timestamped PDF/Portal Evidence Pack Generator.

ideas.name: EAA Web Accessibility Evidence Audit
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: A manual-grade WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit for small EU businesses producing a legally defensible evidence pack, replacing discredited overlay widgets.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For EU e-commerce stores and digital businesses subject to the European Accessibility Act, EAA Web Accessibility Evidence Audit combines automated scanning with guided manual checks for the ~70% of WCAG criteria scanners miss — delivering a defensible evidence pack that withstands regulatory enforcement.
ideas.detailedDescription: The European Accessibility Act (EAA) applied across all 27 EU member states on June 28, 2025; 2026 is the first full year of active national supervision (e.g. French court ordering Carrefour compliance under €500/day penalty). Overlay widgets do not satisfy EAA/ADA standards (1,400+ widget users sued in 2025). Automated scanners catch only 25–30% of issues. This service fills the gap with hybrid manual-grade evidence auditing.

atAGlance.primaryBuyer: E-commerce store owners, digital agencies, SME website managers in the EU
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Manual-grade WCAG audit report for one e-commerce store
atAGlance.primaryRisk: Cheap overlay widgets retain market share despite legal discreditation
atAGlance.killCondition: E-commerce owners refuse paid manual audits in favor of €20/month overlay widgets despite court penalties

ideas.productConcept: Automated scan -> Guided manual human evaluation -> Scored WCAG 2.1 AA evidence report.

ideas.name: Care-Home Evidence Freshness Gate
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: Surfaces the staleness of official care home inspection ratings and layers recent public signals so families selecting care homes do not rely on 7-year-old inspections.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For families choosing residential care for aging parents, Care-Home Evidence Freshness Gate prominently displays inspection rating age (addressing CQC's ~7-year average inspection gap) and overlays recent complaint filings and staff turnover signals.
ideas.detailedDescription: England's CQC publishes ~2,076 care home ratings/year against 15,000 locations (~7-year inspection lag). The CQC chief executive publicly admitted ratings run years out of date. Families making high-stakes £1,000+/week decisions currently rely on stale ratings. This product surfaces rating age and layers recent public signals as a freshness confidence indicator.

atAGlance.urgency: watch — rating staleness documented; consumer monetization requires testing
atAGlance.primaryBuyer: Families seeking eldercare, private care placement advisors
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Public CQC rating staleness lookup dashboard
atAGlance.paymentGate: £29 per detailed care home freshness report
atAGlance.primaryRisk: Consumers rely on free directories despite stale ratings
atAGlance.killCondition: Families show zero willingness to pay £29 for detailed freshness audit report

ideas.productConcept: Rating Staleness Metric -> Public Signal Integration (complaints, job postings) -> Freshness Index.

ideas.name: Cross-Border EU Rental Evidence Gate
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: A document and listing verification layer for cross-border EU renters checking properties against official registry data before deposits are paid.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For Erasmus students, expats, and relocating workers renting across EU borders, Cross-Border EU Rental Evidence Gate verifies property listings against official national registries (such as Italy's mandatory CIN code or Germany's Wunderflats/land registry checks) to eliminate deposit fraud.
ideas.detailedDescription: Over €1.75B lost to rental fraud in the Netherlands alone in 2024 (1% recovery rate). Patterns repeat across IE, DE, IT, CZ. National ID codes (CIN in Italy) are now mandatory for short-term listings. Existing single-country alert tools fail cross-border movers. This service provides structured pre-deposit verification checklists and registry verification.

atAGlance.urgency: live — €1.75B annual fraud; CIN code mandates active
atAGlance.primaryBuyer: Erasmus students, international university departments, expat relocation agencies
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Property verification checklist report for one CZ-DE rental transaction
atAGlance.paymentGate: €19 per verification check or €49 monthly subscription
atAGlance.primaryRisk: Single-country incumbents expand into cross-border workflows

ideas.productConcept: Listing Authenticity Check -> Landlord Identity Verification -> Escrow & Deposit Safety Protocol.

ideas.name: EU Job-Posting Trust Gate
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: A dual verification engine for job postings in the EU combining ghost-job detection with EU Pay Transparency Directive compliance auditing.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For job seekers and compliant employers in the EU, EU Job-Posting Trust Gate verifies active hiring intent to filter ghost jobs while checking postings against mandatory EU Pay Transparency Directive salary range disclosures.
ideas.detailedDescription: EU Pay Transparency Directive transposition deadline passed June 7, 2026. 18–27% of online job postings are ghost jobs with no hiring intent. No existing tool combines ghost-job intent detection with Pay Transparency Directive compliance auditing for EU job seekers.

atAGlance.urgency: live — Pay Transparency Directive deadline passed Jun 7, 2026
atAGlance.primaryBuyer: Job seekers, career coaches, compliant recruitment platforms
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Browser extension prototype checking job postings on LinkedIn EU
atAGlance.killCondition: Job seekers unwilling to pay for browser extension verification

ideas.productConcept: Ghost Job Risk Calculator -> Pay Transparency Directive Compliance Audit -> Trust Badge.

ideas.name: Evidence-Based Fitness Claim Checker
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: Verifies specific workout programs and exercise claims against current peer-reviewed sports-science literature.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For gym-goers and evidence-based personal trainers, Evidence-Based Fitness Claim Checker maps fitness claims and workout routines against PubMed sports-science meta-analyses to separate scientific facts from social media myths.
ideas.detailedDescription: 80% of personal training clients do not know required trainer qualifications. Social media fitness content is dominated by unscientific exercise myths. Registries (NCCA/USREPS) cover trainer credentials; this tool focuses strictly on exercise claim and program evidence verification.

atAGlance.urgency: watch — steady consumer interest; low B2B urgency
atAGlance.primaryBuyer: Fitness enthusiasts, gym-goers, evidence-based personal trainers
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Web-based claim auditor comparing input routine against PubMed meta-analyses
atAGlance.primaryRisk: Low consumer willingness to pay for scientific debunking

ideas.productConcept: Claim Input -> PubMed & Sports-Science Lookup -> Evidence Grade Output.

ideas.name: Continental-EU Vet Pricing Transparency Network
ideas.oneSentenceConcept: A veterinary bill fairness checker and price comparison network for pet owners in continental Europe.
ideas.elevatorPitch: For pet owners in continental Europe facing opaque vet bills, Continental-EU Vet Pricing Transparency Network compares procedure receipts against regional benchmarks and statutory fee scales to evaluate price fairness.
ideas.detailedDescription: UK CMA investigation forced price transparency onto UK vet clinics (VetsCompared launched May 2026). Continental EU markets (FR, DE, ES, CZ) remain highly opaque with corporate clinic consolidation driving fee inflation without clear price disclosure. This network provides bill benchmarks for pet owners.

atAGlance.urgency: watch — UK market leading; EU legislation pending
atAGlance.primaryBuyer: Pet owners, pet insurance companies evaluating claim fairness
atAGlance.firstArtifact: Anonymous vet bill benchmark tool for Germany & France
atAGlance.paymentGate: B2B API licensing to pet insurers
atAGlance.primaryRisk: UK competitors expand to EU before local network scales
atAGlance.killCondition: Pet insurance API partners decline integration

ideas.productConcept: Receipt Upload -> Benchmark Comparison -> Fairness Index.
